faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can people tell it's an AI?
faq.a1: It sounds like a person: pauses, filler words, regional accent. And if someone asks directly, the agent says so — lying costs more than sounding good.
faq.q2: What if someone asks something it doesn't know?
faq.a2: It doesn't make things up. It takes the detail, sends it to you on WhatsApp, and if it's urgent, transfers the call to whoever you decide.
faq.q3: Do I have to change my number?
faq.a3: No. It connects to your current number, or we give you a new one to test without touching anything that already works.
faq.a4: It takes the repetitive stuff. Your team handles what actually needs judgment, with the context already gathered.

services.sub: Accessible AI for businesses in Mexico and the US.
feature1.label: One agent, not a phone tree
feature1.title: Answers the phone the way you would
feature1.body: Sofía sells and Diego receives. Both speak with your information: your services, your hours, your prices, and what you should never promise. No "press 1," no one left waiting.
feature2.label: The calendar fills itself
feature2.title: From the call to the appointment, no middleman
feature2.body: The agent checks your real availability, holds the slot, confirms in writing, and sends the reminder before the appointment. If the customer cancels, it frees the slot and lets you know. You just see the calendar already squared away.
quote.text: A phone that rings and nobody answers is a customer who already called someone else.
voiceFeature.body: Most customers can't tell the difference from a real person. The agent trains on your business info and never gets tired, never runs late, never has a bad day.
faq.q0: Does the chatbot work on WhatsApp and Instagram?
faq.a0: Yes. The Chat Pro plan includes WhatsApp, Telegram, and Instagram. Lower plans include one or two channels — all without changing the number or app your business already uses.
